threads.body: @copilot Please delete `FallbackEnabledInstrumentationModule`. Have each affected OpenTelemetry API bridge and instrumentation annotation module extend `InstrumentationModule` directly and override `defaultEnabled()` to return `true`, following the existing pattern used by internal instrumentations. Update the imports and tests for the deleted helper while preserving the enablement regression coverage. Keep the behavior unchanged: these modules remain enabled when common defaults are disabled, and explicit module enablement settings still take precedence.

replies.body: Addressed in ade6db93. Deleted the helper; all 24 modules now extend InstrumentationModule directly and override defaultEnabled() to return true. Preserved the shared enablement matrix and agent-backed regressions. All 282 scoped tests, Spotless, and Checkstyle passed.
